title: BERT: The Bidirectional Search Engine Rewrite

beats.text: Before BERT. Language models read sentences like horses wearing blinders. They only looked backwards.
beats.visual_focus: A linear sentence where tokens ahead of the cursor are locked behind a dense black barrier.

visual_blueprint.title: UNIDIRECTIONAL TUNNEL VISION
visual_blueprint.sub: Standard models could only process tokens sequentially from left to right

motif_params.title: UNIDIRECTIONAL TUNNEL VISION
motif_params.sub: Standard models could only process tokens sequentially from left

beats.text: Standard models processed text sequentially from left to right. That created massive blind spots. Making true bidirectional context impossible to capture.
beats.visual_focus: A unidirectional vector arrow crawling slowly left-to-right, failing to resolve the ambiguous word 'bank'.

visual_blueprint.title: THE CONTEXT BOTTLENECK
visual_blueprint.sub: Left-to-right sequential conditioning starves ambiguous tokens of crucial future clues

motif_params.title: THE CONTEXT BOTTLENECK
motif_params.sub: Left-to-right sequential conditioning starves ambiguous tokens

beats.text: BERT shattered this bottleneck. Instead of moving in one direction. It conditions on left and right context simultaneously across all layers.
beats.visual_focus: Two opposing light beams collapse into a single dual-directional prism, illuminating the whole sequence at once.

beats.text: By masking random words in the input. BERT forces the neural transformer to predict missing tokens using entire panoramic sentences.
beats.visual_focus: A token tile flips to reveal a '[MASK]' badge, while surrounding tokens send attention rays to reconstruct it.
